enhancedcelestials2core.plus.big_moon.ri: Big Moon — Lower gravity makes jumps higher; items and other entities fall slower too.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.tiny_moon.r: Tiny Moon — Higher gravity makes players and other falling entities heavier.
Miner Moon — Haste I improves mining speed.
Blood Moon — More hostile mobs can spawn.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.eclipse.ris: Eclipse — Nether creatures replace ordinary natural monsters. Ghasts are excluded.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.pink_moon.r: Pink Moon — New hostile mob spawns are blocked. Existing mobs remain.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.grey_moon.r: Pillager Moon — Pillagers and occasional illagers replace ordinary natural monsters.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.harvest_moo: Harvest Moon — Crops grow faster; mature crops can yield extra produce.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.blue_moon.r: Blue Moon — Luck +2 benefits loot that uses the Luck attribute.
Green Moon — Slimes spawn more widely.
Tidal Moon — Fish bite sooner in oceans and rivers; fish populations increase.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.hunters_moo: Hunter's Moon — Wildlife can spawn at night in larger groups.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.howling_moo: Howling Moon — Wolves are more common in their normal biomes.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.shroom_moon: Shroom Moon — Small mushrooms and nearby fungi spread more actively.
Storm Moon — Thunderstorms and extra lightning; lightning cannot ignite blocks.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.meteor_show: Meteor Shower Moon — Rare stone and raw ore fragments appear over grass or snow.
Ender Moon — Endermen and endermites replace ordinary natural monsters; the night feels like the End.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.wanderers_m: Wanderer's Moon — Traders attempt to appear more often and may offer two extra goods.
enhancedcelestials2core.plus.prospectors: Prospector's Moon — Ore mining grants extra XP and occasional extra drops, without faster mining.
